jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll manage key insurance activities across the organisation, respond to changing risk exposures, and help ensure appropriate coverage in line with our insurance policy. You’ll coordinate day-to-day delivery, renewals, tenders, and projects while working closely with colleagues, insurers, and brokers.

**Welcome to Group Risk:

**You’ll be part of Insurance where you, together with your colleagues, will support business units, companies, and regions and manage insurance for the organisation’s global risks. The team consists of seven specialists, primarily based in Gentofte, with two colleagues in London. As a team, we share expertise, take responsibility, and help each other deliver high-quality solutions.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• managing local Danish insurance arrangements, including motor, workers’ compensation, and accident insurance

• coordinating global employee-related insurance programmes for international assignments and business travel

• handling daily enquiries, annual renewals, and relevant tender activities with internal and external stakeholders

• supporting insurance activities for power generation, pipeline, and storage operations, including communication with the business

• coordinating insurance-related technology tasks and contributing to the implementation and continuous improvement of the insurance management system

• leading or contributing to projects in the Insurance team, preparing documents and presentations, and maintaining effective administrative controls.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have an experience with corporate insurance, insurance broking, or a related risk and insurance role

• understand employee-related insurance programmes and have experience with, or a strong interest in, property insurance

• can manage renewals, tenders, enquiries, documentation, and multiple stakeholders with attention to quality and detail

• communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English in an international working environment

• feel comfortable using Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, and can work with business systems such as SAP and SharePoint

• work independently, collaborate openly, take initiative, and stay effective in a changing environment.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr45,000.00- kr65,000.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Are you a curious software developer who enjoys taking ownership and exploring new technologies? At Evosep, you’ll have the opportunity to develop software that supports innovative technologies within protein-based clinical diagnostics. You’ll work on everything from instrument control to the systems supporting our production. You’ll collaborate with passionate colleagues and have the freedom to explore modern approaches such as AI-assisted and agentic development. Most importantly, you’ll be joining a team where your ideas and desire to make a real difference matters. Does this sound like you? Then we'd love to hear from you.

What We Do

Evosep aims to improve quality of life and patient care by radically innovating protein based clinical diagnostics. Making sample preparation and separation

before MS analysis 10 times faster and 100 times more robust will enable truly large cohort studies for biomarker validation and provide the foundation for

precision medicine.

Key Tasks and responsibilities

• Design and develop software solutions that support both current and next-generation Evosep technologies, including software for instrument control, internal production support systems etc.

• Maintain, improve, and support existing and legacy Evosep software systems.

• Stay up to date with emerging technologies, development practices, and methodologies, and explore how they can add value to our solutions.

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive cando attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team. To be successful in this role, you should also ideally bring:

• A couple of years of professional software development experience.

• A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• Enthusiastic about AI-assisted and agentic software development

• A strong sense of ownership and responsibility for tasks and products.

• Experience with C#, C/C++, Lua, and/or Python.

• Experience with firmware development and/or IoT.

• Knowledge of cyber resilience and secure software development.

• Experience working with agile development practices.

• Strong written and spoken English skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.

• A proactive, curious, and collaborative mindset, with the motivation to contribute to a fast-moving international team.

What We Offer

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supporting colleagues with a can-do mentality and a strong belief in our ability to make a real difference with what we do.

• An innovative, open, and dynamic culture where we continuously learn and develop.

• The possibility to join a rapidly growing company in the life science industry where you will contribute to solutions for improving quality of life and

patient care.

• A competitive benefits package and lunch arrangement.

• Flexible work hours and work-life balance.

• New, modern office facilities in Odense.

• The list goes on, learn more about us on www.evosep.com/careers.

Does This Position Sound Like A Match?

Hit the apply button below to apply for the position. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

What Happens After I Send My Application?

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible. We will conduct interviews continuously and we reserve the right to close the job advert as soon as the position has been filled, so do not hesitate to send us an application. It is important to us that we respond to all candidates who have spent time sending us an application and you will always as a minimum receive an email with a response once the hiring process is over.

Living in Odense

Join a thriving life science ecosystem with strong university-industry collaboration and exciting career opportunities. Discover why professionals from around the world choose to live and work in Odense - a city that combines innovation, work-life balance, and exceptional quality of life. Learn more here Career in Odense - Invest in Odense. If you are relocating from abroad, International House Odense offers practical support to help you settle in and navigate life in Denmark

The Senior AI Adoption Lead takes ownership of ALK's continuous AI adoption programme, turning enthusiasm into real, safe, everyday value from the AI tools available to ALK employees. This role continues the adoption efforts from 2025 (over 1,000 employees trained in GenAI usage) and 2026 (more tailored training on ALK's AI solutions) and is key to achieving ALK's AI ambition within the Allergy+ strategy.

This role requires genuine enthusiasm for enabling people, facilitating great learning experiences, and driving change. The Senior AI Adoption Lead must work closely with people across all business areas, be proactive, reach out to employees, and drive AI adoption across the entire organization so that the change is permanent and sticks with employees.

This role owns ALK's continuous AI adoption programme, covering general enablement on GenAI, tailored upskilling for all employees, and engagement activities that drive adoption. This includes preparing and hosting AI training (both general-purpose and tool-specific), the training calendar, micro-learning, maintaining AI at ALK intranet site. The role also owns measuring GenAI usage across the organization, providing the data needed to support informed decisions in AI strategy implementation.

This is not an engineering role – the person does not need to build or configure AI solutions. It does, however, require basic understanding of both business and IT, so the Senior AI Adoption Lead can act as an effective bridge between the two. Genuine enthusiasm for new technologies, especially generative AI, is required. Experience with usage of those technologies in daily life and enterprise scenario is vital.

The Senior AI Adoption Lead acts as a proxy between business and IT: translating technical concepts into everyday business language, aligning business demand with IT delivery, triaging common issues, and accelerating adoption before escalation to IT.

This role is based in Denmark, where ALK has its headquarters and the majority of AI users. It also requires occasional business travel to conduct in-person workshops and training.

Major fields of responsibility:

• 
Communicate the need for AI adoption through meetings, newsletters, MS Teams, and Intranet; share success stories, best practices, and enthusiasm for upcoming initiatives.

• 
Foster engagement through targeted workshops for departments and business units, regular manager briefings, tailored communications, and a visible emphasis on the benefits of AI in daily work.

• 
Map use cases and design training courses (e.g. Foundations, Advanced Prompting, Leading with GenAI) and micro-learning, and activate and coordinate a network of AI Champions to extend reach.

• 
Provide accessible, tiered learning resources through the AI community and Learning Hub (Teams channel, SharePoint) — videos, live webinars, in-person workshops, quick-start guides, FAQs, and playbooks.

• 
Support enterprise-AI pilots with onboarding, enablement and value evaluation; collect feedback and resolve common non-technical issues; and maintain a tight feedback loop with IT on platform updates, governance, and support to keep adoption aligned and safe.

• 
Work side by side with the technical teams (programmers, architects, data and platform specialists): take part in solution and roadmap discussions, learn how the solutions work, ask questions from the end-user perspective, challenge and advise on usability, and translate the outcome into layman terms for the business.

• 
Define and measure adoption rates and satisfaction (usage, surveys, focus groups) and report impact to leadership; run iterative cycles to refine training content based on user feedback and business priorities; and recognize high adopters through awards and acknowledgment.

Qualifications:

• 
Minimum 10 years' experience in change management, IT systems adoption, and training management and delivery

• 
Proven facilitation, training and change-management experience

• 
Outstanding communication and stakeholder skills across all levels

• 
Fluent in English.

• 
Hands-on curiosity about generative AI

• 
Practical experience with creation of AI assistants (e.g. custom skills in Anthropic Claude or custom agents in M365 Copilot).

• 
Analytical mindset able to translate adoption data into actionable insights.

• 
Self-driven, organized and creative, comfortable working across business and IT**.**

About ALK

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

Company Description

Are you motivated by helping people and business functions unlock the value of AI in their daily work? Do you thrive in a role where you influence, enable, and drive change across a large international organisation?

As our new AI Business Enablement Lead, you will play a key role in accelerating AI adoption across JYSK. Based at our Head Office in Aarhus, you will work closely with business leaders and colleagues across functions to turn AI opportunities into practical solutions that create value.

This is a unique opportunity to join a newly established AI function and shape how AI becomes part of the way we work. As the first person in this role, you will help build the foundation for future growth while working closely with the Central AI team and stakeholders across the business.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, we believe that dedication creates opportunities. We offer you a role with a high degree of responsibility, visibility, and influence across the organisation. You will join a company where decisions are made quickly, ideas are welcomed, and colleagues work together with trust, respect, and a shared ambition to improve how we do business.

You will become part of a growing AI function that supports colleagues across JYSK, helping business areas build confidence and capability in using AI. At the same time, you will have excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development in an international environment.

As our first recruit in this new AI function, you will set the benchmark. For the right candidate with a strong, proactive mindset, this role offers a clear path to grow into leading our future team of AI Business Enablement Specialists.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A unique opportunity to shape and drive AI adoption across JYSK

• Significant exposure to senior stakeholders and business leaders across functions

• Close collaboration with AI specialists, engineers, and data professionals

• A workplace built on trust, empowerment, and freedom with responsibility

• A modern Head Office environment in Aarhus with a strong team culture

• Attractive employee benefits, social activities, and staff discounts

• Opportunities for continuous learning, development, and future career growth

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You will act as a trusted partner to business functions, supporting leaders and teams in identifying, prioritising, and implementing AI opportunities. Through training, coaching, stakeholder engagement, and structured change management, you will help ensure that AI becomes a natural and valuable part of daily work across JYSK.

Your success will depend on your ability to build relationships, simplify complex topics, and guide colleagues through transformation in a practical and business-focused way.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Partnering with business leaders to identify, evaluate, and prioritise high-value AI use cases

• Designing and delivering practical AI training, workshops, and enablement activities for business users

• Establishing best practices, reusable frameworks, prompt libraries, responsible AI practices and AI adoption guidelines

• Driving AI adoption strategies and supporting departments on their AI maturity journey

• Collaborating closely with the Central AI team to evaluate initiatives and determine the right solution approach

• Monitoring business impact, and value creation through defined success metrics

• Engage with the broader AI Ambassador network to improve usage and adoption of AI across all units at JYSK.

• Facilitating cross-functional collaboration to reduce duplication and promote shared learning across JYSK

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for someone who combines strong business understanding with the ability to drive change and inspire others. You are comfortable working across functions, navigating ambiguity, and helping colleagues understand how AI can support their goals.

You bring a practical and collaborative approach, and you enjoy turning new technologies into meaningful business outcomes.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 5-7 years of relevant experience

• Holds a degree in Business, Information Systems, Innovation Management, Engineering, or a related field

• Has proven experience driving change management, transformation, or business improvement initiatives across an organisation

• Demonstrates strong practical experience with AI tools, enterprise copilots, prompt engineering, and AI-enabled workflows

• Has excellent stakeholder management skills and can influence without direct authority

• Can assess, prioritise, and communicate business value from AI use cases

• Enjoys coaching and enabling colleagues while creating engagement around new ways of working

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Head of AI, Karan Honavar at +45 2812 8374.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

As a Solution Engineer – Privileged Access Management (PAM) & Identity Infrastructure at TDC NET, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and operating enterprise Identity and Privileged Access Management solutions. You will be responsible for securing privileged access across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, and operational technology while ensuring seamless integration with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, PKI, and modern automation practices.

About the job

Working closely with Infrastructure, Security, Platform Engineering, and Application teams, you will help automate identity services, improve security controls, and improve operational efficiency through Infrastructure-as-Code and modern engineering practices.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise PAM solutions.

• Integrate servers, applications, databases, network devices, and cloud platforms into the PAM ecosystem.

• Manage and support Microsoft Active Directory, Entra ID , LDAP, MFA and related identity services.

• Support and maintain Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including certificate lifecycle management and secure authentication mechanisms.

• Automate PAM and identity-related processes using Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting.

• Monitor platform performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and continuously improve platform stability and security.

• Identify security risks and implement mitigation strategies aligned with enterprise security standards.

• Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

"We are building more than an IAM platform. We are building a modern identity engineering capability. If you enjoy solving complex security challenges, driving automation, and making a real impact, you'll fit right in with our team."

– Abhishek Kumar, Senior Manager – Identity & Access Management, TDC NET

About you

You are passionate about Identity & Access Management, infrastructure security, and automation. You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and continuously improving enterprise security platforms through modern engineering practices.

You thrive in collaborative environments where Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and DevOps come together to build secure and scalable identity services.

Required Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience working with Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), or Security Infrastructure.

• Extensive experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, LDAP, and key authentication technologies.

• Solid understanding & experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificate lifecycle management, TLS/SSL, and authentication mechanisms

• Experience with Keycloak, Hashicorp vault , Ping or equivalent platforms

• Practical experience implementing, configuring, and supporting Delinea Privileged Access Management (PAM), HashiCorp Boundary, or equivalent privileged access solutions.

• Solid understanding of authentication and authorization protocols such as Kerberos, LDAP, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and RADIUS.

• Experience operating in highly regulated enterprise settings, with a solid graspof security frameworks, compliance requirements, and audit controls.

• Extensive troubleshooting skills across Windows, Linux, and enterprise infrastructure.

• Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Applicants are required to meet the criteria for submitting a security clearance application.

Good to Have

• Experience working with HashiCorp Vault for secrets management and privileged credential management.

• Experience using Terraform for Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation.

• Experience using Git and modern version control workflows.

• Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps pipelines.

• Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripting for automation and operational tasks.

• Familiarity with container platforms such as Docker or Kubernetes.

What We Offer

At TDC NET, you'll join a collaborative engineering team focused on building and operating modern Identity and Privileged Access Management services that protect critical infrastructure and enable secure digital transformation.

You'll have the opportunity to work with modern IAM technologies, automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and cloud identity services while influencing technical direction and helping shape the future of our identity engineering capabilities.

If solving challenging security issues and improving identity, automation, and privileged access sounds appealing, we'd be happy to hear from you.

Contact:

Help shape how AI is used at MyDefence from strategy and architecture to working solutions.

AI is moving fast. For us, the ambition is not to adopt technology simply because it is new, but to understand where it can create real value and build the right foundations to use it responsibly.

We are looking for an AI Implementation Lead who can help shape and implement MyDefence’s approach to artificial intelligence. This is a role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of strategy and hands-on technology: someone who can think about architecture, governance and long-term direction – and then turn ideas into proof-of-concepts that demonstrate what is actually possible.

You will join our IT & Security organisation, report to our CISO and become a go-to person for AI across MyDefence, working with teams across the whole global organisation.

What you will do

Your role will span AI strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on implementation. You will help us identify where AI can make a meaningful difference as well as where it should not be applied.

A key part of your role will be turning direction into something tangible. You will build and demonstrate proof-of-concepts, work with technologies such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, agentic frameworks and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and help move successful concepts towards production.

Your key responsibilities will include:

AI strategy, architecture & governance

• Design MyDefence’s AI strategy, together with a Global AI-team, and target architecture, and turn it into concrete, deliverable initiatives.

• Provide governance and oversight of AI adoption, ensuring it is responsible, compliant, and aligned with company priorities.

• Assess opportunities and risks and recommend where AI should and should not be applied.

Technical delivery & proof-of-concept

• Build and demonstrate proof-of-concepts hands-on using tools such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and similar platforms.

• Translate strategy into working implementations and guide their move from concept to production.

Data foundations

• Ensure the data foundations for AI are sound - proper data quality, structures, and governance are prerequisites for reliable AI.

• Work with consultants and internal teams to get data structures right so AI can be implemented and deliver value on top of them.

• Apply business data analytics skills to connect data, AI, and real business needs.

Staying at the frontier

• Track developments across the AI field, including what leading providers such as

• Anthropic and OpenAI are shipping and current best practices.

• Maintain a clear-eyed view of pitfalls and risks so MyDefence adopts the right technologies and avoids the wrong ones.

Who we are looking for

You are curious about where AI is going and focused on turning new technology into real value. You combine technical expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.

You have a relevant degree in computer science, data science, engineering or a similar field or equivalent professional experience, along with experience designing and implementing AI solutions.

We imagine that you bring:

• Proven experience designing and implementing AI solutions, including hands-on proof-of-concept work.

• Hands-on experience with modern AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Copilot-studio.

• Experience working with agentic frameworks and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.

• A solid understanding of data structures, data quality, and business data analytics.

• The ability to communicate AI concepts, opportunities and risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

• Experience with responsible AI adoption and relevant compliance considerations is considered an advantage.

Who you are

You are curious by nature and genuinely interested in where AI is heading, but you also have a critical eye and know how to separate hype from solutions that create real value. You enjoy working in a fast-moving field and are motivated by both exploring new possibilities and turning them into something tangible.

We see you as someone who:

• Is curious and continuously learning, keeping up with developments and best practices within AI.

• Takes a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach, balancing strategic thinking with getting things built.

• Thinks critically about opportunities, risks, and limitations rather than adopting technology for technology’s sake.

• Communicates complex topics clearly and enjoys working with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Works well across teams and is comfortable collaborating with consultants, vendors and partners.

• Is comfortable working in a security-conscious environment where confidentiality and responsible decision-making are essential.

What we stand for

At MyDefence, we live by a shared set of values that guide us – both in how we do business and in our everyday interactions as colleagues. These values are our compass, ensuring that we move toward the same goal with courage, execution, and care.

We Dare (Courage)

We challenge the status quo, embrace new ideas, and have the courage to make decisions that move us forward.

We Do (Execution)

We take ownership, deliver on our commitments, and turn ideas into action.

We Care (I Am Your Wing(wo)man)

We support one another, succeed as a team, and build strong relationships based on trust and respect.

How to apply

If you're motivated by building, improving, and challenging the status quo rather than simply maintaining what's already in place, we'd love to hear from you.

Questions? If you have any questions about the role, please do not hesitate to reach out to Casper Skyum Høgh, who will be happy to provide further details about the position.

Submit your application and CV as soon as possible; we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position once we have found the right candidate.

**Build Hands-on Experience Testing Software For Medical Devices

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. Our sub-scalp EEG solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

You will report to our Senior Director, Technology and work closely with colleagues in Software Test and Software Development. The role gives you practical experience with software testing in a regulated medical device environment while contributing to software quality and important release activities.

**

• Execute manual and/or automated test cases for software features and updates

• Document test results, defects and observations in our test management and defect tracking systems

• Support the creation and maintenance of test cases based on requirements and specifications

• Assist with regression testing ahead of software releases

• Help maintain test documentation and traceability in line with regulatory requirements

• Provide administrative and ad hoc support to colleagues across UNEEG as needed

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Are currently studying computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering or another relevant technical degree

• Preferably have more than one year remaining of your studies

• Work in a structured and detail-oriented way and take ownership of your tasks

• Are curious, self-driven and comfortable working both independently and with others

• Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken

• Are comfortable using standard office and test tools and keen to learn new systems

Previous industry experience is not required. An interest in software testing, quality assurance or medical device software development is an advantage. Familiarity with test methodologies, defect tracking tools or basic scripting is also beneficial.

**Practical information:

**We expect you to work approximately 8–15 hours per week, depending on your studies and planned activities at UNEEG. The role is based at our office in Allerød, and we prefer you to be present in the office at least one day per week on average. We offer flexibility around your studies and exams.

**What we offer:

**

• Relevant hands-on experience in software testing within a regulated medical device environment

• Close collaboration with experienced colleagues who will support your learning

• An opportunity to learn about test processes, tools and Quality Management System documentation

• A friendly workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture shaped by Togetherness, Integrity and Dedication

At UNEEG, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen, at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

jobs.occupation: PhD position in adult clinical psychology/psychotherapy research: Treatments for Complex PTSD
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Copenhagen (UCPH), invites applications for a fully funded 3-year PhD-position from 1 May 2027 or after agreement.  
 
 The position and the project
 The successful candidate will work on the project Treatments for Complex PTSD (RECONNECT-trial), a randomized controlled trial conducted in the Mental Health Services. The project has a strong focus on patient involvement and investigating mechanisms of change within the three intervention arms (Prolonged Exposure, Eye Movement Desensitization Reprocessing and Enhanced Emotional and Interpersonal Skills Training). The project is conducted in collaboration between researchers in psychology and psychiatry.
 
 Duties and responsibilities
 The PhD student will be central in the research project, being involved in and responsible for large parts of the data collection. Most importantly, the PhD-student will be responsible for conceptualizing and conducting a subset of studies. As such, data management and data analyses, as well as manuscript preparation and communication of research results to the scientific community as well as to relevant stakeholders will be central.

  The PhD-student will be responsible for the assessment of the participants with the International Trauma Interview in Danish, overseeing recruitment progress, and conducting quantitative and qualitative research based on survey and interview data. Experience with quantitative and qualitative data analysis is a must. The candidate must have strong clinical skills and preferably with trauma populations. The candidate must be able to work independently under supervision. Collaborative skills and team spirit are in high regard. For the right candidate, there will be ample possibilities to influence the project and develop new project ideas within the project frame.
 
 Supervision and research group
 The PhD-student will be part of a research group at the Department of Psychology conducting psychological and psychiatric research on psychotherapy and trauma.
 
 Qualification requirements
 Applicants must have qualifications corresponding to master’s level related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Psychology. If you have completed your education in Denmark, you must have a master’s degree covered by the collective agreement for academics in the state sector.

  If you have completed your education outside of Denmark, you must either have a master’s degree equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (two years) or as minimum a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor’s degree (three years) and be assessed as having professional qualifications at master's level.

  If you have completed your education outside of Denmark, we may obtain an assessment of your education from the Danish Research Agency.
 
 Place of employment
 The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Copenhagen (https://psychology.ku.dk/) is a vibrant, inclusive workplace hosting a large group of faculty, post docs and PhD-students. The research of the department covers a wide range of topics and methodologies and has an international work environment.

  Strategy of the Faculty of the Social Sciences
 The Department of Psychology is part of the Faculty of the Social Sciences. The faculty is a successful academic community that strives to put knowledge into action by:

   	
• Engaging partners in the co-creation of knowledge, learning and social change. 	
• Empowering our students to become reflective and responsible citizens who have the vision, the knowledge and the competence to change society for the better. 	
• Energizing global, European and Danish communities of knowledge by innovating research methodologies and by research findings with impact   For more on the faculty strategy, see: https://socialsciences.ku.dk/.
 
 The recruitment process
 Further information on the recruitment process at University of Copenhagen can be found here:  https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/
 
 An Equal Opportunity Workplace
 The University of Copenhagen is committed in its pursuit of academic excellence to equality of opportunity and to creating an inclusive working environment and therefore encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, ethnicity etc. For more on the diverse working place environment at the University and the University’s participation in the HRS4R HR Excellence in Research, see https://employment.ku.dk/working-at-ucph/eu-charter-for-researchers/
 
 International applicant?
 The University of Copenhagen offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including support before and during your relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about these services as well as information on entering and working in Denmark here: https://ism.ku.dk/
 
 Contact information
 We encourage you to first consult our website, where most questions concerning the recruitment process as well as the academic content and structure of the PhD programme are answered:

  Structure of the PhD programme

  How to obtain a PhD scholarship.

  For information about the project and the position, please contact PI Assistant Professor Sara Kerstine Kaya Nielsen, sara.nielsen@psy.ku.dk. Information about the recruitment process is available from HR, e-mail: HR-SOENDRE@adm.ku.dk Please refer to ID number: 211-2569/26-2H
 
 How to apply
 Submit a complete application at our online portal. Click on the “Apply now” icon at the bottom of the page to apply. The documents must be in Adobe PDF or Word.  

  Your application must be written in English and include the following documents:

   	
• Motivated application 	
• Curriculum vitae 	
• Diploma (master and bachelor) 	
• Other relevant material   
 The deadline for applications is 1 December 2026.
 Applications or enclosures received thereafter will not be considered.

We’re looking for an Enterprise Data Scientist to join our Data & AI team. If you’re passionate about artificial intelligence, data science, analytics, and transforming data into business value, we want to meet you.

Your key responsibilities

As our Data Scientist, you will:

• Apply core data science methods - statistical modelling, supervised and unsupervised ML, causal inference and experimentation - to concrete business problems such as marketing attribution, forecasting, churn and propensity modelling

Working at Kopenhagen Konsulting

We’re a fast-growing management consultancy specialising in Cybersecurity, Risk & Resilience, Data & AI and Digital. Clients come to us for our ability to blend expertise with momentum: we unblock stalled initiatives and turn business goals into real delivery.

Besides this, we offer:

• Competitive salary

• Significant personal and professional development opportunities

• Every Friday at the Kopenhagen Konsulting office with your colleagues

Location & working arrangements

This is an on-site role based at our office in Copenhagen and at client sites (client location depends on the project). It's not a fully remote role, and we can't offer relocation support. To apply, you must already have the right to work in Denmark.

What you bring

You're driven by turning data and AI into real business impact. You're analytical by nature, quick to pick up new tools and thrive working across disciplines with clients and colleagues alike.

Professional experience

• Strong Python and SQL skills, with hands-on experience in Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

We’d love it if you also tick the boxes below – as a bonus, not a deal-breaker:

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and CI/CD for data and ML

• Experience with GenAI and LLM-based solutions

• Databricks certifications

Personal qualities

At Kopenhagen Konsulting, how you show up matters as much as the experience you bring. We expect that you:

• Own outcomes and deliver reliably

• Are structured and clear in how you work

• Communicate well with stakeholders at all levels

• Are a team player who contributes to a positive culture – for clients and your Kopenhagen Konsulting colleagues

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher in environmental microbial ecology
jobs.description:
The Department of Biology, Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a two-year, fixed-term postdoctoral position in environmental microbial ecology, starting 1 February, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is part of a project funded by the Villum Foundation's Villum Experiment programme.

The project
Electrically conductive iron minerals are widespread in anoxic aquatic sediments, yet we know little about the microorganisms that live on them. The project aims to characterize the phylogenetic identity and ecophysiology of microorganisms associated with these minerals. We hypothesize that, by facilitating extracellular electron transfer, the minerals provide a distinct niche that selectively enriches electroactive microorganisms relative to the surrounding sediment.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a two–year position from 1 February, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 
This is a fixed-term position to end on 31 January, 2029.

Job description
You will identify, visualize and characterize bacterial and archaeal cells associated with iron minerals by combining fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) and correlative imaging, DNA- and/or RNA-based omics, and stable isotope incubation experiments. You will have considerable freedom to shape the methodological approach and to develop your own ideas within the project framework. Project collaborators in Germany will contribute chemical characterization of the minerals, giving you the opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary team. Participation in supervision of BSc., MSc. and PhD students and possibly some classroom teaching is also expected.

Your profile
You hold a PhD in biology, earth and environmental science, biotechnology or a related field (or expect to complete it before the start date), and you have a research background in microbiology or microbial ecology.

Essentials:

• Experience with advanced microscopy and/or molecular microbial ecology methods.
• Interest in microbial physiology and electromicrobiology.
• A systematic approach to method development and testing.
• A publication record in international peer-reviewed journals, relative to your career stage.
• Very good written and oral communication skills in English.
Desirable:

• Experience with FISH, correlative microscopy, stable isotope probing, or omics data analysis.
• Experience working with sediment or other environmental samples.
• Experience with microbial physiology and/or electromicrobiology.
• If you are excited about the project but your experience does not match every point, we still encourage you to apply.
At the Department of Biology, we value a collegial and inclusive working environment and place strong emphasis on good relationships among colleagues and students. We welcome colleagues who bring an open, constructive and collaborative approach.

Who we are
The Department of Biology (Aarhus University) provides a framework for research and teaching in all major biological subdisciplines. The department currently encompasses approximately 200 academic and technical staff and 45 PhD students while 400 students follow the BSc and MSc programs offered by the department. The Section for Microbiology (https://bio.au.dk/en/about-biology/sections/microbiology) employs 12 associate and full professors and offers a vibrant, international research environment for studying microbial physiology, evolution, ecology, and biogeochemistry. The section integrates basic and applied research, addressing the functions, eco-physiology, and evolution of microorganisms in natural and biotechnological systems. The section has well-equipped laboratories, a permanent support staff of highly skilled laboratory technicians, and access to advanced imaging facilities on the AU campus.

What we offer
• A two-year position in a stimulating, international research environment
• Access to state-of-the-art laboratories and imaging facilities.
• A work environment encouraging lively, open and critical discussion.
• A work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities.
• A workplace characterized by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is Aarhus University, and the place of employment is Section for Microbiology within the Department of Biology (https://bio.au.dk/en/), Aarhus University, Ny Munkegade 114, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contact information
Applicants seeking further information are invited to contact Assoc. Prof. Kasper Urup Kjeldsen at AU (kasperuk@bio.au.dk).

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 29 November, 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

At the Faculty of Natural Science at Aarhus University, we strive to support our scientific staff in their career development. We focus on competency development and career clarification and want to make your opportunities transparent. On our website, you can find information on all types of scientific positions, as well as the entry criteria we use when assessing candidates. You can also read more about how we can assist you in your career planning and development.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.500 studerende og 9.000 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,9 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Pig Farm Workers – 2 Positions in Morsø, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are looking for 2 experienced pig farm workers to join a large pig farm in Morsø, Denmark. The farm currently has 3,000 sows and produces approximately 110,000 piglets per year.

Available Positions

1. Farrowing Department (First Priority)

• 
Taking care of sows and newborn piglets.

• 
Assisting with farrowing and piglet care.

• 
Monitoring animal health and welfare.

• 
Vaccinating and moving sows.

• 
Performing daily farm routines.

2. Insemination & Gestation Department (Løbe-Drægtighed)

• 
Artificial insemination of sows.

• 
Vaccinating and monitoring sow health.

• 
Moving sows between departments.

• 
Daily care and management of pregnant sows.

• 
General farm duties.

Requirements

• 
Previous experience working on a pig farm is required.

• 
Good English communication skills.

• 
Responsible, reliable and hardworking.

• 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Salary and Accommodation

• 
Salary: Based on experience.

• 
Accommodation: Apartment available for 6,000 DKK per month (optional).

jobs.occupation: Farm Worker – Cattle, Calves & Sheep | Stavanger, Norway
jobs.description:
We are looking for a responsible and motivated farm worker to join a livestock farm near Stavanger, Norway. The position involves working with cattle, calves and sheep, including animal care and assistance during the calving season.

Location: Stavanger, Norway
Start Date: 1 December 2026
Employment Period: Until April/May 2027

Job Responsibilities

December – February:

• 
Feeding and taking care of calves and sheep.

• 
Cleaning animal housing and maintaining hygiene.

• 
Monitoring animal health and welfare.

• 
Performing general daily farm duties.

March – April (Calving Season):

• 
Assisting cows and sheep during the birthing season.

• 
Taking care of newborn calves and lambs.

• 
Monitoring animals and providing necessary assistance.

• 
Supporting additional farm tasks during the busy season.

Please note: Milking is not part of this position.

Requirements

• 
Previous experience working with farm animals is an advantage.

• 
Responsible, reliable and hardworking.

• 
Interest in animal care and willingness to learn.

• 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• 
Willingness to work overtime during the busy calving season when required.

Salary and Accommodation

• 
Salary: 220–230 NOK per hour (before tax).

• 
Accommodation: Available for 3,000 NOK per month.

• 
Start Date: 1 December 2026.

• 
Contract Duration: Approximately until April/May 2027, depending on the farm's needs.
